svg.title: Many agents, one API
svg.desc: On the left, the providers the runtime registers today, each with the native channel its state is read from and the observation level its adapter reports: antigravity, transcript log, native-log; claude, hooks, to a loopback bridge, native-hooks; codex, app-server, JSON-RPC, structured; copilot, session events log, native-log; grok, session log, ACP to control, native-log; hermes, tui_gateway, WebSocket, structured; kimi, wire log, native-log; opencode, private serve, HTTP + SSE, structured; pi, session log, native-log; acp, any Agent Client Protocol agent, structured. A dotted row below them is the next agent: one more adapter. Their lines meet in the runtime, and one line leaves for a single object, Agent, with: status, idle, working, blocked; turn, started, completed; tool, requested, completed; interaction, permission, question; context-window, used of capacity; usage, tokens; workspace, file operations; submitPrompt, a receipt. The same object for every agent.
